title: [3.0.0] CGM Eversense integration does not work
symptom: In AAPS 3.0.0, BG reading from Eversense does not work. Previously it worked with patched ES apk -> ESEL -> MM640g in AAPS, but now BG values are simply not available. As a workaround, values can be obtained via xDrip+ with 640g/Eversense as source, but the direct connection seems broken.
evidence_quote: the BG reading from Eversense does not work in AAPS 3.0.0. For older versions, it worked with patched ES apk -> ESEL -> MM640g in AAPS. But this does not work with the new AAPS version. The BG values are simply not available.
